verdict: VERDICT FLIPPED (Oct 2): Ascended Heroes has held its value better since release: AH26 81.01 (100 = Feb 2026) vs PRIS25 70.82 (100 = Jan 2025) at the Sep 28 mark (−19.0% in ~8 months vs −29.2% in ~20); at the same age (8 months) PRIS25's reconstructed level was 61.28 (Sep 2025, recon, labelled). Reverses the Sep 27 verdict (old Aug 24 base); over the shared Aug 24 window PRIS25 still fell less (−6.4% vs −11.5%) and AH26 has four straight weekly falls (−5.8% latest). Top three sold-comp medians $2,167.40 vs $1,813.00 (Umbreon ex SIR $1,125.00 the single biggest; AH Mega Gengar ex SIR $835.00 and Pikachu ex SIR $834.90). PE is the cheaper ETB (lowest ask $130.00, 41 live, vs $149.00, 14 live); bundles $76.00 vs $74.99 (Oct 2).
